nextStoryContext: US-013 added src/supervisor/events.ts (WorkerEvent / WorkerEventLogger / buildResultDetail / readWorkerTokens) and emits worker-start/worker-end/result/tokens from runSupervisor to .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl. officialDocsValidated.summary: AC#3 said 'append via Bun.file', but Bun.write is async and overwrites, FileSink is async, and there is no synchronous Bun.file append; Bun ships a near-complete node:fs implementation. Used synchronous appendFileSync to match the supervisor's all-synchronous injected I/O and the existing node:fs idiom in usage.ts/next.ts. The file-logger test proves the append empirically.
